newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends easier on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends easier on dollar demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.2970/3000 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday against a previous close at 43.2850/2950, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 43.2920/2980 per dollar in early trade but lost ground due to demand for dollars from nationalised banks.
"Two nationalised banks did not respond to buyers as they had their own requirements (of dollars)," said one dealer. "The greenback invariably gains when these banks demand (dollars)."
Call money was traded at 6 percent to 7 percent against the previous 7.0-7.5 percent. -- Dhaka newsroom +880-2-506363
